resumeLine: Operated a payments webhook handler processing 2M events/month with at-least-once delivery.

answers.text: Stripe retries until we return 200, so we get at-least-once delivery. We verify the signature and then credit the account.
It handles the webhooks and credits accounts.
At-least-once means duplicates are expected, and we did not dedupe on the event id — a retried delivery credits the account twice. We also decode the body before verifying the signature.
At-least-once delivery, so nothing is lost.

seededDefects.description: At-least-once delivery is claimed but the handler applies every delivery; a retried webhook double-credits the account.
The body is parsed before the signature is verified, so unsigned input reaches the parser.
